@kit.AbilityKit is recommended. Android Intent maps to Want in HarmonyOS NEXT for inter-ability navigation, data passing, and implicit/explicit routing.

namespace_mappings.android_display: Apache XML Security (XML Sig / XML Enc)
namespace_mappings.note: @kit.CryptoArchitectureKit provides the underlying cryptographic primitives (RSA, AES, SHA) for XML digital signatures and encryption. XML-level processing must be re-implemented using HarmonyOS NEXT crypto APIs.

@kit.UserAuthenticationKit is recommended for passkey and biometric credential management. AndroidX Credential Manager maps to UserAuthenticationKit; use @kit.AccountKit for Huawei ID-based federated sign-in.
@kit.CryptoArchitectureKit is recommended as the BouncyCastle equivalent. HarmonyOS NEXT provides cryptographic operations (AES, RSA, EC, hash, HMAC, PQC primitives) via the system crypto framework.

@kit.BasicServicesKit is recommended. Guava collections, caching, and utility classes map to ArkTS built-in data structures and @kit.BasicServicesKit utilities.

Commons Lang3 string/array/reflection utilities have no ArkTS-level equivalent. Migrate to ArkTS built-in string methods for simple cases, or port to C++ using HarmonyOS NDK (libc++) for performance-critical native code.
@kit.NetworkKit is recommended. Apache HTTP Client (DefaultHttpClient, HttpGet, HttpPost) maps to @kit.NetworkKit HTTP request APIs.
@kit.BasicServicesKit is recommended. JSONObject/JSONArray usage maps to ArkTS built-in JSON.parse/JSON.stringify. No additional library needed on HarmonyOS NEXT.
@kit.NetworkKit is recommended. Volley request queues and HTTP stack map to @kit.NetworkKit's HTTP request and connection pool APIs.
No direct RxJava equivalent on HarmonyOS NEXT. Replace Observable/Flowable chains with ArkTS async/await, Promise chains, or the @Concurrent decorator for parallel tasks.
@kit.AnalyticsKit is recommended. Google Data Transport is an internal Firebase telemetry layer; equivalent event dispatch is handled by AGConnect analytics pipelines.
@kit.PushKit combined with @kit.ArkUI is recommended. Firebase In-App Messaging maps to PushKit-triggered in-app notification flows built with ArkUI overlay components.
@kit.BasicServicesKit is recommended. Firebase Components is an internal dependency-injection runtime; no direct HarmonyOS equivalent is needed — AGConnect SDK handles initialization internally.
@kit.BasicServicesKit is recommended. Firebase Encoders is an internal serialization layer; use ArkTS JSON.stringify or @kit.ArkData for equivalent data encoding.
@kit.BasicServicesKit is recommended. Firebase Concurrent provides internal thread pool utilities; replace with ArkTS async/await and @Concurrent worker thread patterns.
@kit.PerformanceAnalysisKit (AGConnect APM) is recommended for crash reporting, performance tracing, and error monitoring as the HarmonyOS NEXT Sentry equivalent.
No native Freshchat SDK for HarmonyOS NEXT. Implement in-app chat using @kit.ArkWeb (WebView) with the Freshchat web widget, or evaluate alternative HarmonyOS-compatible customer support SDKs.
@kit.TelephonyKit is recommended for phone number validation and formatting. For full libphonenumber feature parity, consider bundling the JS port via @kit.ArkWeb or porting to ArkTS.
@kit.NetworkKit is recommended. Loopj AsyncHttpClient request/response patterns map directly to @kit.NetworkKit asynchronous HTTP APIs.

Multi-select media picking → @kit.MediaLibraryKit photoAccessHelper.

This row straddles two kits: Base64/hex encoding lives in util.Base64Helper (import { util } from '@kit.ArkTS'), while message digests (DigestUtils / MD5 / SHA) live in cryptoFramework.createMd (import { cryptoFramework } from '@kit.CryptoArchitectureKit'). Mapped to @kit.CryptoArchitectureKit because the digest half has no other home; Base64-only users should prefer @kit.ArkTS util.
IOUtils / FileUtils stream and file operations → @kit.CoreFileKit. Attested: import { fileIo } from '@kit.CoreFileKit' (openSync, readSync, mkdirSync, listFileSync).

Logging → hilog. Attested: import { hilog } from '@kit.PerformanceAnalysisKit' (debug, isLoggable). NOTE: this is a rough fit, not an equivalence — the Android library is a pluggable-backend logging facade (the app binds logback/log4j at deploy time); HarmonyOS has no facade/binding layer, so appenders, MDC and per-logger levels need real rework.
Runtime permission request/check → @kit.AbilityKit. Attested: import { abilityAccessCtrl } from '@kit.AbilityKit' (verifyAccessToken, checkAccessToken).
Runtime permission request/check → @kit.AbilityKit abilityAccessCtrl; same target as com.zoontek.rnpermissions.
Connectivity state and change callbacks → @kit.NetworkKit. Attested: import { connection } from '@kit.NetworkKit' (hasDefaultNet, getNetCapabilities, createNetConnection).
Flutter connectivity_plus → @kit.NetworkKit connection; same target as react-native-netinfo.

Zip archive create/extract → @kit.BasicServicesKit. Attested: import { zlib } from '@kit.BasicServicesKit' (compressFile, decompressFile). zlib has no per-entry API, so zip4j's entry-level manipulation and AES encryption have no direct counterpart.
Zip/unzip → @kit.BasicServicesKit zlib compressFile/decompressFile.

In-process pub/sub → @kit.BasicServicesKit. Attested: import { emitter } from '@kit.BasicServicesKit'. Rough fit rather than equivalence: emitter carries no counterpart to EventBus sticky events, subscriber priorities or ThreadMode dispatch, so those need rework.

FCM remote messaging → @kit.PushKit; matches the existing com.google.firebase.messaging row. NOTE: the @kit.PushKit token rests on existing mapping.json precedent (4 rows) and KIT_DOC_URLS, not on an index import statement — hmos_api_index.json attests no @kit.PushKit import.

Analytics events → @kit.PerformanceAnalysisKit, matching the existing com.google.firebase.analytics row. Attested: import { hiAppEvent } from '@kit.PerformanceAnalysisKit' (addWatcher) and import { hilog } from '@kit.PerformanceAnalysisKit'. Chosen over @kit.AnalyticsKit, which the index does not attest at all.

JSON parse/serialize → ArkTS. Attested: import { ArkTSUtils } from '@kit.ArkTS' (parse, stringify); the JS builtin JSON also covers most fastjson usage. Fastjson's JSONPath and TypeReference generics have no direct counterpart and need rework.

Icon-font rendering → @kit.ArkUI. Attested: registerFont, SymbolGlyph, fontFamily. Medium because there is no drop-in icon-font component: the HarmonyOS equivalent is a composition (registerFont plus Text with fontFamily, or SymbolGlyph), not a single API.
Secure credential storage → @kit.UniversalKeystoreKit. Attested: import { huks } from '@kit.UniversalKeystoreKit' (generateKeyItem, importKeyItem, exportKeyItem).

File read/write/download → @kit.CoreFileKit. Attested: import { fileIo } from '@kit.CoreFileKit' (openSync, readSync, mkdirSync, listFileSync). RNFS upload/download helpers map to @kit.BasicServicesKit request instead.
Conceal encrypted storage → @kit.CryptoArchitectureKit. Attested: import { cryptoFramework } from '@kit.CryptoArchitectureKit' (createCipher, createSymKeyGenerator, doFinal).
Conceal Android keychain half → @kit.CryptoArchitectureKit; same target as com.facebook.crypto. Key material itself belongs in @kit.UniversalKeystoreKit huks.
PDF viewing → @kit.PDFKit. Attested: import { pdfService } from '@kit.PDFKit' (PdfDocument, loadDocument).

Logging → hilog. Attested: import { hilog } from '@kit.PerformanceAnalysisKit' (debug, isLoggable). NOTE: rough fit, not equivalence — hilog is a platform log SINK, while SLF4J is a pluggable-backend FACADE whose whole purpose is that the app binds logback/log4j at deploy time. HarmonyOS has no facade/binding layer. org.slf4j.MDC and org.slf4j.helpers.* are exactly the parts that do not port; appenders and per-logger levels need real rework, not a symbol swap.

Cookie get/set/clear → @kit.ArkWeb. Attested: import { webview } from '@kit.ArkWeb' (configCookieSync, fetchCookieSync, saveCookieAsync). Cookies are managed by the web stack on HarmonyOS, not by @kit.NetworkKit.
Barcode/QR scanning → @kit.ScanKit. Attested: import { detectBarcode } from '@kit.ScanKit' (also generateBarcode, scanCore).

Barcode/QR decoding → @kit.ScanKit. Attested: import { detectBarcode } from '@kit.ScanKit' (also generateBarcode, scanCore). NOTE: this is a vendored ZXing copy bundled INSIDE the DCloud uni-app runtime. @kit.ScanKit is correct for the barcode-scanning capability itself, but the surrounding uni-app runtime is not separately mappable (Phase 2C classified io.dcloud/uts/com.dcloud as SKIP - a whole cross-platform runtime, not a library). Do not read this row as 'swap one library'.
Barcode detection → @kit.ScanKit. Attested: import { detectBarcode } from '@kit.ScanKit' (also generateBarcode, scanCore).
Biometric authentication → @kit.UserAuthenticationKit. Attested: import { userAuth } from '@kit.UserAuthenticationKit' (getUserAuthInstance, UserAuthType, AuthParam).

Fingerprint authentication → @kit.UserAuthenticationKit. Attested: import { userAuth } from '@kit.UserAuthenticationKit' (getUserAuthInstance, UserAuthType, AuthParam). The FingerprintCipher/FingerprintDialog split maps onto userAuth plus @kit.UniversalKeystoreKit huks for key binding.
PDF rendering core → @kit.PDFKit. Attested: import { pdfService } from '@kit.PDFKit' (PdfDocument, loadDocument).
PDF viewer component → @kit.PDFKit. Attested: import { pdfService } from '@kit.PDFKit' (PdfDocument, loadDocument).
Mask overlay → @kit.ArkUI. Attested: Mask, maskShape. No drop-in component exists: the HarmonyOS equivalent is a composition, not a one-for-one widget swap.
Checkbox control → @kit.ArkUI. Attested: Checkbox, CheckboxGroup — a direct component equivalent.
Date/time picker → @kit.ArkUI. Attested: showDatePickerDialog, DatePickerOptions (and showTimePickerDialog for the time variant).

Toolbar / app bar → @kit.ArkUI. Attested: Toolbar. No drop-in component exists: the HarmonyOS equivalent is a composition, not a one-for-one widget swap. ArkUI expresses this through the Navigation component's title bar and toolbar slots rather than a standalone Toolbar widget.
Pull-to-refresh → @kit.ArkUI. Attested: Refresh, a direct container equivalent. SmartRefresh's custom header/footer animations map onto Refresh's builder slots.

Splash screen → @kit.ArkUI window. Attested: setWindowLayoutFullScreen (import { window } from '@kit.ArkUI'). No drop-in component exists: the HarmonyOS equivalent is a composition, not a one-for-one widget swap. HarmonyOS has no splash-screen API as such; the launch experience is an ability-level start page plus window configuration.

Process relaunch → @kit.AbilityKit. Attested: terminateSelf (and process.exit from @kit.ArkTS). Medium because HarmonyOS exposes no true process-restart primitive — terminateSelf plus startAbility approximates it, with different lifecycle semantics.
App restart → @kit.AbilityKit terminateSelf plus startAbility; same caveat as com.jakewharton.processphoenix — there is no true process-restart primitive.
Location fixes and change callbacks → @kit.LocationKit. Attested: getCurrentLocation (import { geoLocationManager } from '@kit.LocationKit').
Calendar event CRUD → @kit.CalendarKit. Attested: import { calendarManager } from '@kit.CalendarKit' (getCalendarManager, addEvent).

SVG rendering → @kit.ImageKit, which accepts SVG as an image source (index key 'svg tags' resolves to import { image } from '@kit.ImageKit'). For programmatic path-level rendering the closer API is drawing.buildFromSVGString (import { drawing } from '@kit.ArkGraphics2D'); medium because AndroidSVG spans both roles.

Video playback → @kit.MediaKit. Attested: createAVPlayer (import { media } from '@kit.MediaKit'). The bundled ExoPlayer surface (com.brentvatne.exoplayer) is replaced by AVPlayer plus an ArkUI XComponent/Video surface.
Video transcoding / compression → @kit.MediaKit. Attested: createAVTranscoder (import { media } from '@kit.MediaKit').

Date/time, calendar systems and timezone data → @kit.LocalizationKit. Attested: import { i18n } from '@kit.LocalizationKit' (getTimeZone, getCalendar). Time4J is large — its calendar-system breadth exceeds i18n, so exotic calendars may need rework.
Screen keep-awake → @kit.BasicServicesKit. Attested: import { runningLock } from '@kit.BasicServicesKit' (RunningLockType).
Package name / version / build number → @kit.AbilityKit. Attested: import { bundleManager } from '@kit.AbilityKit' (getBundleInfoForSelf, getBundleInfo).
